3.notes: Pipedrive exposes a REST API authenticated by an API token (see developers.pipedrive.com/docs). OpenAPI specs and sandbox available. Evidence: https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1

12.notes: Intercom developer docs provide onboarding for a free development workspace and app integration flow; standard OAuth2 flows used for public apps. Evidence: https://developers.intercom.com/

21.notes: Slack apps use OAuth2 (user/bot tokens) and the API docs are public. Evidence: https://api.slack.com/

27.notes: Telegram Bot API uses a Bot token (single string) obtained from BotFather; public docs at core.telegram.org. Evidence: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api

34.notes: HighLevel provides public API docs and notes an OAuth-based API (API 2.0). Evidence: https://developers.gohighlevel.com/ and https://public-api.gohighlevel.com/

41.notes: Shopify apps use OAuth2 and have extensive developer docs and CLI tooling. Evidence: https://shopify.dev/

56.notes: Public developer docs exist at https://docs.firecrawl.dev; auth is a Bearer API key (fc-...). Docs also show a keyless quickstart tier for basic testing before signup. Evidence: https://docs.firecrawl.dev/ and https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/scrape

63.notes: Netlify supports Personal Access Tokens (PATs) for scripts and OAuth2 for public integrations; API docs include examples and rate limits. Evidence: https://docs.netlify.com/api/get-started/

71.notes: Notion supports personal access tokens, internal/public connections and OAuth2 for public apps; docs show clear quickstarts. Evidence: https://developers.notion.com/

81.notes: Stripe uses secret API keys and a public docs site with examples; keys are obtainable from a Stripe dashboard. Evidence: https://stripe.com/docs/api

90.notes: PitchBook's commercial product pages are public (https://pitchbook.com) but API/feeds are gated behind enterprise contracts; public developer docs were not accessible without login. Evidence: https://pitchbook.com/

92.notes: Otter's Public API uses Bearer token/API key auth (created via Sign in > Integrations > Developer tab), but is gated to Enterprise workspaces only and requires an account manager to enable. Otter also has an MCP server for querying an existing Otter archive. Evidence: https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/36130822688279-Otter-ai-Public-API and https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/4412365535895-Does-Otter-offer-an-open-API

96.notes: Devin has public docs and an API reference at https://docs.devin.ai; auth is via Bearer token/API key from a 'service user'; onboarding requires signing up at https://app.devin.ai. Enterprise tier adds RBAC/multi-org support. Evidence: https://docs.devin.ai/api-reference/overview and https://devin.ai/

99.notes: YouTube Data API (Google) supports API keys for read-only requests and OAuth2 for user-authorized access; enable in Google Cloud console. Evidence: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3
